title: Sliding selection
description: A shared highlight keeps its momentum as you move between options.
useCase: Make a view selection feel connected without moving labels or adding unrelated content.
reducedMotion: Keyboard selection and reduced-motion updates are immediate.
limitations: An isolated accessible selection example with a visually hidden current-view panel; connect selection to real product content when installing.
look: Light warm-grey page with a rounded grey track holding three sans-serif labels, the selected one on a white rounded pill with a faint shadow.
motion: Clicking a tab slides the white highlight to it with a fairly stiff spring (stiffness 460, damping 34) via a shared layout animation; keyboard selection jumps instantly.
adapt: The highlight is a `motion.span` with `layoutId`, rendered only inside the selected tab; tune its spring in `transition`. Replace `views` and the visually hidden `tabpanel` with real panels, keeping `canAnimate` and the roving `onKeyDown` focus.
